International scholarships International Undergraduate Scholarship Starting an undergraduate degree at ARU? This scholarship can help with the costs of study. The scholarship is a fee discount. We will deduct it from your tuition fees in each year of your course. Value There are two levels of award. Lower award – up to £5,000 £2,000 in the first year of your course* £1,000 in each subsequent year of your course (up to a maximum of three subsequent years) You must successfully complete each year to get £1,000 in the subsequent year *If you are studying at ARU in Writtle, you will automatically get £2,000 in your first year. Higher award – up to £7,000 £4,000 in the first year of your course £1,000 in each subsequent year of your course (up to a maximum of three subsequent years) You must successfully complete each year to get £1,000 in the subsequent year Eligibility You should be: an international student (international tuition fee payer) a new student, joining ARU for the first time starting a taught undergraduate course at ARU in Cambridge, Chelmsford, Peterborough or Writtle studying full-time, unless there are exceptional circumstances preventing full-time study starting in Year 1 to receive £2,000 (Lower Award) or £4,000 (Higher Award) If you are starting in Year 2 or Year 3, you will receive £1,000 in each year of your course. If you have Accredited Prior Certified Learning (APCL), discounts will be adjusted on a pro-rata basis. This scholarship cannot be combined with any other scholarships. However, you can get a Full Payment Discount in Year 1 if you pay your fees in full before teaching starts. The scholarship is not available during work placements or for: pre-sessional English courses ARU College courses foundation degrees online / distance learning courses degree apprenticeships or other work-based degrees Study Abroad programmes Depending on the terms and conditions of your funding body, you may not be eligible if you are: sponsored by an organisation such as an employer, charitable body, or government department receiving federal tuition fee loans How to apply There is no need to apply. You will automatically receive our International Undergraduate Scholarship if you meet the eligibility criteria. You must meet all conditions of registration before the scholarship is awarded. If you withdraw from your course, we will adjust the scholarship on a pro-rata basis. How we assess your application We review applications from all eligible international students. For the Lower Award, we assess the overall standard of your application, including entry qualifications. For the Higher Award, we assess the overall standard of your application. It should exceed minimum requirements, including entry qualifications. Questions? Speak to our international team. Email [email protected] or call+44 1245 683680. Undergraduate Scholarships Undergraduate Merit Scholarship Our Undergraduate Merit Scholarship is open to undergraduate students from the UK (and eligible EU/EEA students) who achieve 120 UCAS tariff points from A Levels, BTEC or equivalent qualifications. Who is it for? UK or eligible EU students studying a full-time undergraduate degree. How much is it worth? £1,000. How do I apply? You’ll automatically receive our Undergraduate Merit Scholarship if you meet the eligibility criteria and register as an ARUL student. Top Achievers Scholarships of £2,000 are available for the overall top achievers in Year 0, Year 1 and Year 2. Each year several scholarships are available to our top achievers throughout all courses and modules. The winners are presented with their scholarships during our Top Achievers event hosted three times a year. The scholarship is applied to your next academic year's tuition fees. Postgraduate Scholarships Masters Scholarship Programme ARU London provides several scholarships each year across our three postgraduate intakes. All applicants are offered the chance to receive a scholarship of up to 50% off their Master's Degree. To enter applicants must write 750 words or more about their previous degree, particular area(s) of interest within the field of business, and why they wish to study for a postgraduate degree. Please send all entries to uk@london.aru.ac.uk with the subject: ARU London MSP - <Application ID> - <Full Name>. Please ensure you have submitted your application for admission before sending your scholarship application. Intake Deadline for Consideration September: September 7 th 2026 January January 4 th 2027 May: April 26th 2027 This scholarship is not available for international students. Please note that this scholarship will be applied to the full tuition fee of the course. No other scholarships can be combined with the Masters Scholarship Programme. ARU Alumni Scholarship All alumni of ARU London will be offered a £2,000 scholarship if they wish to continue their studies at ARU London. Master’s Entry Scholarship Any applicant who has achieved a First Class honours degree from a university in the UK will be offered a £1,000 scholarship upon admission. Sports If you're a talented athlete, apply for our Anglia Ruskin Sports Scholarship worth £1,000 . We take great pride in the fact that some of the most talented sportsmen and women in the country choose to study with us. We also understand how difficult it can be to balance the demands of competing at the highest level with a full academic life when you first arrive at university. We offer students competing at regional, national, or international levels, the opportunity to apply for a scholarship award worth up to £1,000 per year for three years. Each award is tailored towards the needs of the athlete and is delivered as a package of support that’ll add value to existing training programmes to help achieve both academic and sporting success. You can apply for a scholarship by contacting enquiry@london.aru.ac.uk or calling 0207 400 6784. About Us Why ARU London? Anglia Ruskin supports the Self-Regulatory Principles for Online Behavioral Advertising of the Digital Advertising Alliance (DAA), the Digital Advertising Alliance of Canada (DAAC), and the European Interactive Digital Advertising Alliance (EDAA). If you opt out of advertising cookies, you may still see Anglia Ruskin ads on other sites, but those ads will not be customized by us or our service providers and we will continue to customize your experience on our website via our use of cookies you have not refused. Alternatively, privacy settings in most browsers will allow you to prevent your browser from accepting new cookies, have it notify you when you receive a new cookie, or disable cookies altogether. If your browser is set to not accept any cookies, you will not receive Interest-Based Advertising, but your use of the Anglia Ruskin service may be impaired or unavailable. In addition, if you use our cookie tool to opt-out of certain cookies, your opt-out preferences will be remembered by placing a cookie on your device. It is therefore important that your browser is configured to accept cookies for your preferences to take effect. If you delete or clear your cookies, or if you change which web browser you are using, you will need to set your cookie preferences again. Note that from time to time we are over-inclusive in which cookies are listed in the opt-out tool. For example, we do not use Facebook, Twitter or Google cookies in all regions. Lifespan: Most cookies are session cookies (which are only active until you close your browser) or are cookies which are only active for one day. Deletion of these types of cookies may result in limited functionality of our service. Lifespan: Most cookies are only active for one day. Some cookies are active for a longer time, ranging from 3 to 12 months. Advertising Cookies Advertising Cookies These cookies use information about your use of this and other websites and apps, your response to ads and emails, and to deliver ads that are more relevant to you and for analytics and optimization purposes. These types of ads are called "interest-based advertising" and will be shown to you outside the Anglia Ruskin domain. Anglia Ruskin uses contractual and technical measures designed to prevent advertising partners from accessing information regarding specific title selections you make, URLs you land on, or shows you have watched on our service.
